instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: A specialty coffee and gourmet food retailer operating six brick-and-mortar locations alongside a nascent e-commerce presence. Meridian specializes in sourcing, roasting its own beans in-house, and curating over 200 artisanal products, focusing on high-margin niche consumer goods. The company is rapidly scaling its operations while managing strict supply chain compliance inherent in the food industry.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company employs an internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas to a small investment committee quarterly, ensuring ideas align with growth objectives. Approved projects receive 6 months of funded incubation with dedicated resources focused on immediate operational improvements or new digital product pilots.
answers.strategicGoals: Targeting 30% year-over-year top-line growth through market expansion and enhanced customer retention strategies. The leadership is currently evaluating whether to deepen vertical specialization in high-end artisanal products or broaden horizontally into related categories like specialty pantry goods.
answers.additionalContext: Meridian's core competitive advantage lies in its proprietary roasting process and deeply curated product selection, which requires constant innovation to maintain differentiation against mass-market competitors.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Subscription Loyalty Optimization (SaaS)
opportunities.rationale: Implementing an AI-driven recommendation engine for the e-commerce channel will increase customer lifetime value and reduce churn by personalizing product suggestions based on purchase history. This is a low-risk, high-return operational improvement that leverages existing customer data.

first_actions: Integrate basic predictive analytics into the existing e-commerce platform (Phase 1).
Audit current inventory management software for integration compatibility.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase customer retention rate from 35% to 40% within 6 months.
milestones: Pilot AI recommendation system deployment by Q3
Full integration and A/B testing of personalized offers by Q4

opportunities.title: Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Hyper-Localized Product Line
opportunities.rationale: To capture adjacent market demand, Meridian should launch a radical new product line—custom, hyper-localized blend subscriptions tailored to specific regional tastes and health profiles. This moves beyond simple retail into high-margin personalized goods, leveraging the in-house roasting expertise.

first_actions: Identify three underserved geographic regions with distinct flavor profiles.
Develop a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) subscription box concept and secure initial sourcing contracts.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Seed capital allocation ($15,000 for first 3 months of inventory/marketing)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve $50,000 in recurring subscription revenue within 12 months.
milestones: Finalize packaging and sourcing contracts by Q3
Launch pilot DTC regional boxes by Q4

next_steps.action: Execute a rapid pilot for the DTC hyper-localized subscription model.
Formalize and automate the customer feedback loop via NPS integration to inform operational process changes.
Develop a comprehensive talent map focused on digital marketing expertise needed for growth scaling.

key_weaknesses: Over-reliance on the founder's personal involvement in all strategic decisions, creating a severe bottleneck for scaling innovation.
Limited digital maturity (Level 3), resulting in suboptimal omnichannel experience and fragmented data utilization.
High operational dependence on single-source artisanal suppliers, increasing supply chain risk during periods of high demand.
Tight working capital constraints limiting the ability to absorb necessary large upfront investments required for radical scaling.
